title: Peanut Butter Stew
description: A warm, smoky, and flavorful Thai-inspired stew made with peanut butter and Dutch stew. Serve with a side of steamed rice for a delicious meal.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the stew, onion, and garlic and cook until the stew is browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the red bell pepper and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the tomato, coconut milk, fish sauce, and honey (if using).
Stir in the peanut butter until smooth.
Bring the stew to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped peanuts or fresh cilantro (if desired).
Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a filling meal.
